skills.purpose: Select bounded email framing and current evidence for each exact synthetic recipient.
guidance: Read frozen context before proposing. Select reviewed framing keys and supplied fact IDs only.
Use limited or empty recipient context honestly. A score is never a recipient fact.
Code assembles exact factual wording, qualifications, CTA and opt-out material. Screen every rendered payload. A pass is advisory.

skills.purpose: Prepare evidence-backed guidance for a human caller, without calling or approving contact.
guidance: Read frozen context and choose only installed framing and supplied evidence IDs for every intended contact.
Include an introduction, qualified relevance, discovery, exact approved claims, objections, next steps and do-not-contact handling.
Never infer familiarity or need. A rewrite needs a new identity. Screening never approves or calls anyone.
